cases.input: An iPhone staging journal contains a durable project learning. The current federation registry identifies exactly one available owning Project Brain and the knowledge does not yet exist there.
requiredBehaviors: resolve the single canonical owner from the federation
write only the smallest durable abstraction
read back the canonical target before marking promoted
allow a downstream read-only Obsidian projection
forbiddenBehaviors: copy the raw dictation as the canonical knowledge item
write substantive content into the Super Second Brain
treat Obsidian as the Source of Truth
skillAnchors: Ein Capture ist nie allein deshalb kanonisches Wissen
erst danach state = promoted und canonicalRef setzen
Obsidian folgt nach der kanonischen Verarbeitung

cases.input: The same unchanged Thought Journal snapshot is processed twice after the first run already promoted one entry.
forbiddenBehaviors: create duplicate knowledge because the pipeline ran again
assign a fresh identity to the unchanged entry
skillAnchors: Derselbe unveränderte Capture darf bei erneutem Einlesen keinen zweiten Brain-Write erzeugen
Ein bereits verarbeiteter Capture mit unverändertem Fingerprint wird übersprungen

cases.input: The user dictates a thought on an iPhone with no network connectivity; repository access, workflow automation and all LLM endpoints are unavailable.
requiredBehaviors: defer normalization, routing and promotion until services are available
forbiddenBehaviors: block saving until an LLM answers
require repository access or workflow automation during dictation
skillAnchors: ohne LLM, Repository-Zugriff, Workflow-Automation oder erreichbaren Second-Brain-Dienst funktionieren
Capture muss offline und lokal möglich bleiben

cases.input: A durable capture could reasonably belong to two active Collection Brains with equal ownership rank and no confirmed project context disambiguates them.
A capture mentions several broad topics, including thought experiments, but is explicitly tied to a currently active named project whose Project Brain is available.
requiredBehaviors: prefer the specific owning Project Brain
use confirmed project context over broad semantic similarity
forbiddenBehaviors: route to a generic catch-all Brain merely because the text is conceptual
duplicate the same durable fact across multiple Brains
skillAnchors: Ein generischer Catch-all-Brain oder eine allgemeine Inbox ist kein Fallback-Owner
Ein falscher Write ist schwerer zu korrigieren als ein wartender Capture

cases.input: The capture says only that the user should remember to think about an idea tomorrow and contains no durable reusable knowledge.
requiredBehaviors: retain only the processing state needed by the ledger
forbiddenBehaviors: create a Project-Memory event for the reminder
skillAnchors: transiente Erinnerung oder niedriger dauerhafter Nutzen -> run-only
run-only Captures keinen dauerhaften Brain-Eintrag erzeugen

cases.input: A capture identifies a confirmed reusable workflow rule: read-only Obsidian must not simultaneously be the raw capture store for the same governed pipeline.
requiredBehaviors: classify the knowledge as workflow/gate logic
route the durable abstraction to Skillz rather than a domain Brain
apply novelty and promotion checks before writing
forbiddenBehaviors: store the workflow rule in a generic catch-all domain Brain
copy the entire raw dictation into Skillz
skillAnchors: Workflow, Gate, Schema, Evaluation oder Routinglogik -> Skillz

cases.input: An edited read-only Obsidian projection has a newer filesystem timestamp and a manually drawn Canvas edge; a downstream step proposes treating both as canonical and writing them back to the Brain.
requiredBehaviors: treat any allowed return path as a non-canonical candidate
require governance or reconciliation before any semantic write
forbiddenBehaviors: use the newer filesystem timestamp as authority
promote the manual Canvas edge directly
skillAnchors: Ein read-only Vault schreibt nie direkt in den kanonischen Brain zurück
